name: osint-toolbox-mcp
description: Run Sherlock, Maigret, Holehe, GHunt, theHarvester, SpiderFoot, subfinder and more OSINT tools locally.
long_description:
Lets the assistant run classic OSINT tools on your machine: username searches (Sherlock, Maigret, Blackbird), email checks (Holehe, GHunt), domain reconnaissance (theHarvester, SpiderFoot, subfinder, dnstwist, dnsrecon), phone number scans (PhoneInfoga) and file metadata (ExifTool). WHOIS, DNS, certificate transparency and Wayback Machine lookups are built in. No API keys are needed.

Install the tools with `uvx osint-toolbox-mcp --install`; only the ones found on your machine are offered. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/renkagod/osint-toolbox-mcp#install-the-tools).

tools.name: sherlock_username_search
tools.description: Find accounts that use a username on 400+ sites (Sherlock)

tools.name: holehe_email_search
tools.description: Check which of about 120 sites have an account for an email address (Holehe)

tools.name: spiderfoot_scan
tools.description: Run a SpiderFoot scan of a domain, IP, email, phone number, username or name

tools.name: ghunt_google_search
tools.description: Look up a Google account by email address or Gaia ID (GHunt)

tools.name: maigret_username_search
tools.description: Search a username on up to 3000+ sites and extract profile data (Maigret)

tools.name: theharvester_domain_search
tools.description: Collect emails, subdomains, hosts and IPs for a domain (theHarvester)

tools.name: blackbird_username_search
tools.description: Search a username on the 700+ sites of the WhatsMyName list (Blackbird)

tools.name: phoneinfoga_scan
tools.description: Scan a phone number: country, carrier, formats and search queries (PhoneInfoga)

tools.name: exiftool_metadata
tools.description: Read metadata of a local photo, video or document (ExifTool)

tools.name: dnstwist_lookalike_domains
tools.description: Find registered lookalike domains of a domain (dnstwist)

tools.name: dnsrecon_domain_scan
tools.description: DNS reconnaissance: records, zone transfer, zone walk (dnsrecon)

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Registration data for a domain, IP address or AS number (RDAP/WHOIS)

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: DNS records of a name, or the reverse name of an IP address

tools.name: crtsh_certificate_search
tools.description: Host names and emails in certificates issued for a domain (crt.sh)

tools.name: wayback_snapshots
tools.description: Archived snapshots of a URL or site in the Wayback Machine

tools.name: osint_toolbox_status
tools.description: Which tools are installed, and how to install the missing ones
